dvids.title: CENTCOM Launches Task Force to Disrupt Iranian Ground Transit Routes Supporting Illegal Shipments
dvids.desc: TAMPA, Fla. — On Nov. 7, the commander of U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) directed the establishment of a task force that will support ongoing U.S. government efforts to prevent Iran from using ground routes to transport advanced weapons and other materials.
